# `task_handoff`

**Record a task handoff.** Store bounded agent assertions with current daemon facts. Auto is note-only; non-auto records a restart request, without performing a restart.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Capability | `task_handoff` |
| Side effect | `update` |
| Idempotency | keyed on `idempotency_key` |
| Retry safe | no |
| Timeout | none |
| Preview | not supported |
